{{Quote|Alpha-02, an aberrant Kaminoan clone of Jango Fett, became obsessed with rebuilding the clans, and recruited two hundred soldiers from police units on the planet Mandalore, along with former members of the Death Watch. These new Supercommandos comprised the Mandalorian Protectors, and they struck against the Republic at Null, Kamino, and New Bornalex.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
'''New Bornalex''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[bluffbeast]] creature. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], New Bornalex was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]; however, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was a part of the Republic's enemy, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As one of the Confederacy's fortified holdings, it was [[Battle of New Bornalex|besieged]] by the Republic during the conflict's [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. New Bornalex was the homeworld of the half-[[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]], half-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]], and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the anti&ndash;[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] activist [[Auren Yomm Baobab]] trained the [[Caldera's Crest]] [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla]] group on the world.

==Description==
New Bornalex was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GatORW" /> located in the [[New Bornalex system/Legends|New Bornalex system]], a part of the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]<ref name="EAOC New Bornalex" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA New Bornalex" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC New Bornalex" /> The [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] linked it to the [[Belsmuth system/Legends|Belsmuth]], [[Katraasii system/Legends|Katraasii]], [[Shadren system/Legends|Shadren]], [[Sheris system/Legends|Sheris]], and [[Solaest system/Legends|Solaest systems]].<ref name="TEA New Bornalex" /> The world was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the creature known as the [[bluffbeast]], which was similar to the ten-[[Limb/Legends|legged]], [[Hair/Legends|furred]] [[mogo]] pack animal of the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]<ref name="GatORW" /> in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]].<ref name="EAOC Roon">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]]</ref>

==History==
By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="CloakDate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified New Bornalex senator|senator]] represented New Bornalex in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Cloak" /> At some point by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="RystallDate">Per {{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/artofrev/2005/05/artofrev20050531.html|series=Art of Revenge|text=Rystáll's Return}}, [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]] was present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="RystallSpecies">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' establishes that [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]] was a half-[[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]], half-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]]. Since {{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}} describes [[Rystáll Sant's father|Sant's father]] as a Theelin, her [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Cyl Sant]], must have been Human.</ref> [[Cyl Sant]] and her [[Hybrid/Legends|half]]-[[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll]] moved from New Bornalex to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the Republic,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> in search of a better life.<ref name="Insider67" />

[[File:Battle_of_New_Bornalex.jpg|thumb|right|300px|New Bornalex was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.]]
During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], New Bornalex fell within the territory controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with the [[Tenth Army|Tenth Sector Army]] of the Republic being tasked with engaging the Confederacy's [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] in the world's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" /> By 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]], the Confederacy had fortified New Bornalex as one of its holdings during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] phase of the war.<ref name="TEA" /> Eventually, the Republic assaulted<ref name="EGTW" /> and laid siege to the world<ref name="TEA" /> in what became known as the [[Battle of New Bornalex]],<ref name="DB Bacara">{{DB|character|commanderbacara|Bacara, Commander}}</ref> with New Bornalex in the process being one of the Republic targets<ref name="Insider80">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> that came under assault by the Confederacy-aligned [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]].<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

The Human [[Athlete/Legends|athlete]] and anti&ndash;[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] activist [[Auren Yomm Baobab]] trained the infamous [[Caldera's Crest]] [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla]] group on New Bornalex during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], imparting to them survival techniques as well as the skill of handling the world's bluffbeast creatures. Said work earned her the respect of the Alliance.<ref name="GatORW" /> Later, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians']] role in the Clone Wars battle on New Bornalex was noted in the [[36 ABY]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|chronicle]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
New Bornalex was first mentioned in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]''.<ref name="Cloak" /> The world was [[Tuckerization|named after]] the ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan [[Alex Newborn]].<ref name="EndorExpress">{{EndorExpress|url=author/Alex|text=Article & Posts by Alex Newborn}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the New Bornalex [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby the world itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA New Bornalex" />
